title: Linux 'Cancer' vs. Open Source: History Repeats Itself? #shorts
description: From Linux in 2001 to AI models in 2026, history repeats. Open source is called a 'cancer' and 'communist' by tech giants. The more things change... #OpenSource #TechHistory #AI #Linux #BigTech
